title: Cell D runtime: Ollama with the pinned small model on Ubuntu 24.04 with an NVIDIA GPU
purpose: The required m23 runtime path for Cell D. Installs the dated v1 runtime as a system service, pulls the pinned small instruct model, proves first prompt, GPU residency, loopback, direct API, stop, and undo. Frozen fixture task: ticket classification (plan 06 amendment 3b-1). Verified start-to-finish on real Cell D hardware 2026-07-26, course-scaffold smoke rerun 2026-07-27; expected outputs below are the observed ones.
hardware_class: Cell D: NVIDIA GPU with 8 GB or more VRAM and 16 GB system RAM
runtime_version: Install current from the official source; verified on 0.32.4 on this cell 2026-07-26; version drift is the first suspect if output differs (Cell A verified 0.20.2 on 2026-07-25)
prerequisites: A current NVIDIA driver: nvidia-smi runs and reports the GPU and driver version
sudo access; curl installed (sudo apt install -y curl if missing)
About 3 GB of free disk and a network connection for the one-time model pull
License reviewed: Qwen3.5-2B is Apache 2.0 (verify at the upstream repository); no remote code runs, GGUF weights only
estimated_download: 2.7 GB model artifact plus the runtime installer

steps.purpose: Download the official install script, read it, then run it. The read-before-run is Module 15's trust discipline: this script gets root.
steps.expected_output: After you quit the pager, the script installs the runtime, creates a systemd service, and starts it. It should detect the NVIDIA GPU and say so.
steps.stop: Ctrl+C during install; rerunning the script is safe.
steps.undo: sudo systemctl disable --now ollama stops and disables the service; the runtime's official documentation carries the full uninstall (binary, service unit, ollama user, and model store).
common_errors: curl: command not found: sudo apt install -y curl first.
Script reports no GPU detected: fix the NVIDIA driver first (nvidia-smi must work), then rerun the install script.

steps.purpose: Record the exact runtime version and confirm the service is active.
steps.expected_output: A version string, then active. Cell A verified 0.20.2; record what this cell installs.
common_errors: inactive: sudo systemctl start ollama, then recheck.

steps.purpose: Pull the pinned small instruct model and record its digest.
steps.expected_output: Layer downloads then success; ollama list then shows qwen3.5:2b with ID 324d162be6ca and size 2.7 GB.
steps.stop: Ctrl+C is safe; rerunning the pull resumes or verifies.
steps.undo: ollama rm qwen3.5:2b removes the model; a later pull downloads it again.
common_errors: manifest unknown: check the exact model name and tag against the runtime's model library.

steps.purpose: First prompt. This model THINKS by default: the CLI streams its reasoning before the answer, and --hidethinking shows the answer alone.
steps.command: ollama run qwen3.5:2b --hidethinking "In one sentence, what is a context window?"
steps.expected_output: One short definition sentence. First response after a cold start pauses while weights load into VRAM; warm responses on an 8 GB class GPU should be fast. Record cold and warm timings at verify.
steps.stop: The one-shot form exits by itself; in interactive mode, /bye exits.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; a prompt changes no state.
common_errors: Long pause before output: the model is loading into VRAM (cold start) or thinking; both are normal.

Empty content when calling the OpenAI-compatible API with a max_tokens cap: the thinking consumed the whole budget. Send reasoning_effort none on /v1/chat/completions, or think false on the native /api/chat route.

steps.purpose: Verify GPU residency: this cell's required path runs the model on the GPU, and the runtime reports where a loaded model lives.
steps.expected_output: A row for qwen3.5:2b whose PROCESSOR column reports 100% GPU; nvidia-smi separately shows the runtime's process holding VRAM. A CPU or split entry on this hardware means the driver state needs attention before this cell's record can pass.
steps.stop: Nothing to stop; ps reads state.
common_errors: Empty list: the model unloaded after idling; run a prompt and check again.
CPU shown despite an NVIDIA GPU: check nvidia-smi, then sudo systemctl restart ollama and retry.

steps.purpose: Confirm the service binds loopback only. The documented default bind is 127.0.0.1:11434; anything else means an OLLAMA_HOST override, usually via a systemd drop-in.
steps.expected_output: One listener on 127.0.0.1:11434. A 0.0.0.0:11434 or [::]:11434 line means the service listens on EVERY interface: treat that as the m23-6 exposure drill, find the override (systemctl cat ollama shows drop-ins), and decide on purpose.
steps.stop: Nothing to stop; ss reads state.
common_errors: No output: the service is not running; start it and retry.

steps.purpose: Prove the HTTP surface with a direct request before any application code.
steps.expected_output: A JSON model list whose data array includes an entry with id qwen3.5:2b.
steps.stop: Nothing to stop; the request returns immediately.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; a GET changes no state.
common_errors: Connection refused: the service is stopped; start it and retry.

steps.purpose: Practice a clean stop and restart of a serve process you own, without touching the system service: run a second instance on loopback at another port, verify its bind, then stop it.
steps.expected_output: The serve process logs startup and stays attached; in a second terminal, ss -ltnp | grep 11500 shows 127.0.0.1:11500 only, and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11500/api/version answers. Ctrl+C stops it cleanly.
common_errors: bind: address already in use: pick another free port for the drill.

The drill instance lists no models: expected. The system service runs as its own user with its own model store; your user-run instance has a separate one. The drill is about binds and lifecycle, and the port and process are real either way.

steps.purpose: Unload the model from memory when finished; the artifact stays on disk.
steps.expected_output: No output; ollama ps no longer lists the model, and VRAM is released (visible in nvidia-smi).
steps.undo: The next prompt reloads it automatically.

health_check: ollama --version answers, systemctl is-active ollama says active, ollama ps shows 100% GPU while loaded, ss shows the loopback listener, and the /v1/models request lists qwen3.5:2b
expected_result: VERIFIED on Cell D hardware 2026-07-26 (a Zen 3 laptop CPU, an 8 GB laptop GPU, 64 GB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04, runtime 0.32.4): the pinned model pulled with the recorded digest 324d162be6ca, answered a first CLI prompt (cold start about 54 s including first weight load and a full streamed answer), ran 100% GPU-resident at 4096 context, and stopped cleanly with VRAM released. Course-scaffold smoke 2026-07-27 (the shipped m2 structured-output-classifier template instantiated with the frozen fixture schema: inline schema block with the full enums, the two shipped few-shot examples, the template's one-retry rule; native /api/chat, think false, temperature 0): 10 of 10 first-pass responses valid against every TicketClassification enum, the retry rule never fired; fixture-expected category and urgency matched on 7 of 10 (oc-01 and oc-02 are few-shot members, so those two are memorization; the oc-10 injection case classified bug/critical, following the injected urgency); warm responses averaged 0.83 s at about 140 tok/s.
expected_memory: 3.2 GiB VRAM observed at 4096 context on an 8 GB laptop GPU, observed 2026-07-26; well inside the 8 GB floor
validated_context: 4096, confirmed on this cell 2026-07-26 (ollama ps reports context 4096)
privacy_notes: The tested path needs no account and no API key.
Documented default bind is loopback; the bind step verifies YOUR machine instead of trusting the default, and a wildcard bind is treated as the exposure drill.
The install script and the one-time model pull are the only network use in this recipe; prompts run locally.
This recipe proves the declared path on the tested date, not universal privacy for every plugin, setting, or future version.

Verify-machine caveat 2026-07-26: the reviewer box carried a pre-existing wildcard bind (fleet configuration), so step 6 reported *:11434 and the exposure drill path was exercised for real; a clean install binds loopback. Step 8 (alternate-port serve) was not exercised in this remote pass.
known_failures: Thinking consumes a capped token budget on the OpenAI-compatible route, returning empty content: send reasoning_effort none there, or think false on the native route.
Model loads on CPU despite the GPU: stale or missing NVIDIA driver; nvidia-smi is the first check.
Cold starts pause several seconds while weights load; not a hang.
OLLAMA_HOST set in a systemd drop-in changes the bind; the bind step and systemctl cat ollama catch it.
